title: Chemical & Pharmaceutical Reactors
desc: Equipment for controlled chemical and pharmaceutical reaction processes.
principle: An agitator circulates the charge while heating or cooling may be applied through an external circuit.
application: Batch reaction and formulation
features: Dished vessel, shaft seal, process nozzles and drain

title: GMP / Semi-GMP Reactors
desc: Process reactors designed around hygienic construction requirements.
principle: Mixing and temperature control are designed around the batch and the required cleaning strategy.
application: Pharmaceutical intermediates and formulated liquids
features: Drainable geometry, cleaning connections and access points as specified

title: Limpet Coil Reactors
desc: Reaction vessels with external half-pipe coils for thermal circulation.
principle: A thermal fluid circulates through a half-pipe coil welded to the shell, transferring heat through the vessel wall.
application: Batch heating and cooling
features: Half-pipe coil, thermal-fluid connections and agitated vessel

title: Jacketed / Double Jacketed Reactors
desc: Jacketed reaction equipment for heating and cooling applications.
principle: Heat transfer fluid circulates in the annular jacket around the process shell.
application: Temperature-controlled reaction, dissolution and mixing
features: Inner shell, external jacket, service nozzles

title: Stainless Steel Reactors
desc: Stainless steel reaction equipment for compatible process media.
principle: Agitation and service connections can be arranged to support the reaction and product transfer.
application: Batch processing of media compatible with the selected stainless grade
features: Dished head, process connections and optional thermal circuit

title: Polyol Reactors
desc: Reaction equipment for polyol processing and associated thermal duties.
principle: The charge is mixed while heat input and removal follow the process formulation.
application: Polyol batch processing
features: Agitator, feed connections and thermal service circuit

title: Shell & Tube Heat Exchanger
desc: Indirect heat transfer through a tube bundle and shell.
principle: Two fluids exchange heat through tube walls while flowing through separate shell-side and tube-side circuits.
application: Process cooling, heating and heat recovery
features: Shell, tube bundle, tubesheets, channel heads and baffles

title: Falling Film Heat Exchanger
desc: Heat transfer using a liquid film flowing along a surface.
principle: A distributor spreads liquid into a thin film over heated or cooled surfaces.
application: Heat-sensitive liquid processing and evaporation duties
features: Liquid distributor, heat-transfer surface and collection zone

title: Water / Industrial Heat Exchanger
desc: Heat exchange equipment for utility and industrial process duties.
principle: Process and utility fluids flow through separate circuits to transfer heat across a metal wall.
application: Cooling water loops and process temperature control
features: Separated circuits, service connections and access for maintenance

title: Reboiler
desc: Heat transfer equipment supporting vapor generation in separation systems.
principle: Heat supplied to column bottoms produces vapor that returns to the separation column.
application: Distillation and solvent recovery
features: Vapor return, liquid inlet and heating service connections

title: Condenser
desc: Equipment for condensing process vapors by removing heat.
principle: Cooling removes sensible and latent heat to convert vapor into liquid.
application: Distillation overheads and vapor recovery
features: Cooling circuit, vapor inlet and condensate outlet

title: Distillation / Process Column
desc: Vertical process equipment for separation and mass transfer.
principle: Vapor and liquid contact across trays or packing to transfer components between phases.
application: Fractionation and solvent recovery
features: Column shell, internals supports and process nozzles

title: Industrial / High Pressure Vessel
desc: Fabricated containment equipment for specified industrial pressure duties.
principle: The enclosed shell and heads contain process media at the design conditions specified for the duty.
application: Gas or liquid containment under specified conditions
features: Shell, dished ends, support and connections

title: Chemical Reaction Vessel
desc: Vessels for chemical processing and reaction operations.
principle: Reactants are charged into a vessel for controlled contact, with mixing where specified.
application: Chemical batch synthesis and intermediate processing
features: Process inlet, outlet and optional agitator mount

title: Stainless Steel / Mild Steel / Carbon Steel Storage Tank
desc: Storage tanks in specified stainless, mild or carbon steel construction.
principle: A containment shell holds liquid between upstream and downstream operations.
application: Bulk liquid storage and process buffering
features: Tank shell, vent connections, drain and access provisions

title: Chemical / Industrial Storage Tank
desc: Storage equipment for compatible chemical and industrial media.
principle: Media are received and held until transfer, with venting and materials selected for the stored chemical.
application: Chemical feedstock storage and intermediate holding
features: Fill and discharge connections, vent and access opening

title: Milk / Water / Oil Storage Tank
desc: Storage equipment configured for the intended liquid and service conditions.
principle: Liquid is held for transfer, with cleaning and temperature provisions chosen for the service.
application: Dairy liquids, industrial water and compatible oils
features: Drain connection, access and optional insulation

title: Vertical / Horizontal Storage Tank
desc: Storage tanks configured to suit available space and process requirements.
principle: A vertical or horizontal shell stores liquid according to footprint, headroom and access constraints.
application: Utility and process liquid storage
features: Legs, skirt or saddles appropriate to the selected orientation

title: Underground Storage Tank
desc: Storage tank construction for specified underground installation conditions.
principle: A below-grade vessel holds liquid with transfer and monitoring typically accessible at grade.
application: Below-grade utility or process liquid storage
features: Access risers, vent connections and installation-specific protection

title: Air / Nitrogen Receiver Tank
desc: Receiver vessels for compressed air or nitrogen systems.
principle: A receiver buffers compressed gas and helps manage fluctuations in demand.
application: Compressed air and nitrogen distribution
features: Gas inlet and outlet, drain and protection connections

title: GMP / Insulated Tank
desc: Storage vessels with hygienic or thermal insulation requirements as specified.
principle: Insulation limits heat exchange with the surroundings while the storage shell contains the product.
application: Temperature-sensitive process and hygienic storage duties
features: Insulated shell, product connections and access

title: Mixing & Storage Vessel
desc: Vessels combining storage and mixing operations.
principle: An agitator circulates the contents during blending or holding.
application: Batch makeup and intermediate storage
features: Agitator mounting, vessel and transfer connections

title: Rotocone Vacuum Dryer (RCVD)
desc: Rotating conical vacuum drying equipment for suitable solid products.
principle: A rotating double-cone vessel tumbles solids under vacuum while heat reaches the product through the wall.
application: Vacuum drying of suitable wet solids
features: Double-cone body, rotary coupling and vacuum connection

title: Rotary Vacuum Dryer (RVD)
desc: Rotary equipment for drying under vacuum.
principle: A rotating or internally agitated chamber renews solids exposure to heated surfaces under vacuum.
application: Drying powders and granules with limited thermal exposure
features: Drying chamber, drive, heating and vacuum connections

title: Fluid Bed Dryer (FBD)
desc: Drying equipment using a fluidized bed of particles.
principle: Air passes through a distributor and suspends particles, carrying away moisture.
application: Drying granules and powders suited to fluidization
features: Air distributor, product bowl and exhaust filtration

title: Fluid Bed Processor (FBP)
desc: Fluid-bed equipment for specified particle processing applications.
principle: Fluidizing air suspends particles while an application-specific spray system can introduce liquid.
application: Fluid-bed drying, coating or granulation duties
features: Product bowl, air distributor, filtration and optional spray assembly

title: Vacuum Tray Dryer (VTD)
desc: Tray-based drying equipment operating under specified vacuum conditions.
principle: Product rests on trays in an evacuated heated chamber, reducing the temperature needed for evaporation.
application: Static batch drying of heat-sensitive solids
features: Vacuum chamber, shelves, trays and sealed door

title: Hot Air Tray Dryer
desc: Tray drying equipment using heated air circulation.
principle: Heated air circulates across trays and carries away evaporated moisture.
application: Batch drying of suitable powders, granules or solids
features: Insulated chamber, tray racks and recirculating air path

title: Agitated Nutsche Filter Dryer (ANFD)
desc: Equipment integrating solid-liquid filtration, washing and drying duties.
principle: Pressure differential draws liquid through a filter plate. An agitator can redistribute cake for washing and drying.
application: Solid–liquid separation, cake washing and vacuum drying
features: Filter plate, sealed vessel, lift drive and cake discharge

title: Ribbon Blender
desc: Horizontal blending equipment for compatible powders and bulk solids.
principle: Inner and outer helical ribbons move powder in opposing axial directions within a trough.
application: Dry powder blending and compatible low-liquid formulations
features: Trough, ribbon shaft, drive and discharge gate

title: Octagonal Blender
desc: Rotating octagonal vessel for bulk material blending.
principle: The rotating polygonal chamber lifts and tumbles particles to redistribute them.
application: Gentle blending of free-flowing powders or granules
features: Faceted chamber, trunnion mounts and discharge

title: Double Cone Blender
desc: Rotating double-cone equipment for blending powders and granules.
principle: Two opposed cones continuously divide and recombine the powder bed as the vessel rotates.
application: Dry blending of flowable materials
features: Double-conical body, supports and charge/discharge ports

title: V-Type Blender
desc: V-shaped tumbling equipment for suitable dry blending duties.
principle: Rotation repeatedly splits and recombines material across two angled vessel arms.
application: Free-flowing dry powders and granules
features: V-shell, access covers and discharge valve

title: Egg Shape Blender
desc: Rotating egg-shaped vessel for specified blending applications.
principle: A rotating curved chamber redistributes material through repeated tumbling.
application: Gentle blending duties suited to tumbling
features: Curved chamber, supports, drive and discharge

title: BIN Blender
desc: Bin-based blending equipment for material handling and mixing.
principle: A docking mechanism secures a detachable bin for rotation and subsequent transfer.
application: Contained batch blending and intermediate transfer
features: Bin, locking cradle and drive

title: Cage Blender
desc: Cage-supported tumbling equipment for compatible blending duties.
principle: A rotating cage holds a compatible container while its contents tumble.
application: Container-based blending of flowable solids
features: Cage, restraint hardware and drive

title: Contra Rotary Mixer
desc: Mixing equipment using counter-rotating mixing elements as specified.
principle: Counter-rotating mixing elements produce relative motion through the batch.
application: Viscous formulations and emulsification support
features: Concentric shafts, opposing drives and vessel

title: Planetary Mixer
desc: Mixing equipment for specified viscous or other process materials.
principle: Mixing tools rotate on their own axes while orbiting the chamber to sweep the batch.
application: Pastes and viscous batch formulations
features: Planetary drive, tool heads and bowl

title: Magnetic Mixer
desc: Mixing equipment using a specified magnetic drive arrangement.
principle: A magnetic coupling transmits torque through a barrier to an impeller.
application: Sealed liquid mixing duties
features: Drive coupling, containment barrier and impeller

title: Agitator
desc: Shaft and impeller assemblies for specified mixing duties.
principle: A driven shaft turns one or more impellers to circulate the process fluid.
application: Suspension, blending and heat-transfer support
features: Shaft, impeller, mounting and sealing arrangement

title: Homogenizer
desc: Equipment for specified dispersion and homogenization applications.
principle: A rotor-stator or other application-specific high-shear assembly disperses components into a more uniform mixture.
application: Emulsions and dispersions
features: Drive and high-shear working head

title: Rapid Mixer Granulator (RMG)
desc: Equipment for mixing and wet granulation of suitable materials.
principle: An impeller blends solids with liquid binder while a chopper helps break up agglomerates.
application: Wet granulation for pharmaceutical and related formulations
features: Bowl, impeller, chopper and discharge

title: Starch Paste Kettle
desc: Kettle equipment for preparing starch paste and similar process mixtures.
principle: Heat and agitation disperse starch and develop a paste at the process conditions.
application: Binder preparation and similar batch cooking duties
features: Kettle, agitator and thermal service connections

title: Multi Mill
desc: Milling equipment for specified particle size reduction.
principle: A rotor moves feed against a screen to reduce particles to a suitable size range.
application: Granule sizing and process particle-size reduction
features: Feed hopper, rotor, screen and discharge

title: Vibro Sifter
desc: Vibratory screening equipment for separating particles by size.
principle: A vibratory drive moves material across a screen so smaller particles pass through the mesh.
application: Powder screening and size classification
features: Screen deck, vibration drive and separate outlets
detail: Vibrating screen deck and spring mounts
